remarks: Discover this spacious and inviting 3-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartment located in Stamford's desirable Glenbrook neighborhood, just moments from the train station, parks, and shopping. This wonderful unit boasts a generous floor plan with a large living room and formal dining room that opens seamlessly onto a private deck-perfect for relaxing outdoors. The large kitchen features ample cabinet space and a pantry for excellent storage. You'll love the convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer, and parking is a breeze with a 1 car private garage, 1 off-street parking space for your use, plus plenty of additional on-street parking. Don't miss this rare find in a prime location!
